subject: general
question: The natural growth rate of a population is analysed by which of the following factors?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Crude Birth and Death Rates__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Natural Growth Rate of a Population is analyzed by **Crude Birth and Death Rates.**
 
• It is used to measure the degree to a population which is growing.
 
• The difference of Birth and Deaths is divided by 10 to convert this rate into a percentage. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population growth is determined by the factors mentioned below:**

 
 
• **​Rates of birth.**
 
• **Death.**
 
• **Immigration.**
 
• **Emigration.**
